SECOND DESIGN REVIEW · AFTER IMPLEMENTATION

What to improve next.

The original obstruction and truncation issues are improved. The next pass should focus on confirmation context, information density and Duo pose acceptance.

01 · HIGH PRIORITY · DUO ACCEPTANCE

Validate the inner display before calling Duo support complete.

Outer-display fixes are visible, but this pass still has no evidence for the inner screen, rotation, book/tabletop folds or opening and closing.

Next change: Run the full pose matrix; use current window geometry and reserved regions for pane boundaries. Preserve selected pass, scrolling and reminder state through transitions.

Implementation directionAllPassesView · PassView · ArrangementView prototype

These are design judgments from the updated screenshots and source review, not measured conversion results.

02 · HIGH PRIORITY · CONFIRMATION CONTEXT

Keep the chosen reminder time beside confirmation.

At accessibility2, the pinned button remains visible while lower event options, lead time and the final alert timestamp move out of view.

Next change: Add a concise, wrapping summary of selected event and alert time to the bottom area. Keep content scrollable; verify long dates, custom offsets and the largest text settings.

Implementation directionPassAlarmSettingsModalView.swift

These are design judgments from the updated screenshots and source review, not measured conversion results.

03 · MEDIUM PRIORITY · HOME DENSITY

Reduce secondary reading before the first observation.

The alert action is earlier, but the location and full station name still occupy substantial space at larger text. Upcoming passes remain below the fold.

Next change: Use an accessible short station label with the full name available to VoiceOver; move location detail to its selector and give upcoming opportunities a stronger place on wide windows.

Implementation directionObservationHomeView.swift

These are design judgments from the updated screenshots and source review, not measured conversion results.

04 · MEDIUM PRIORITY · CHART TIMELINE

Show the next event without hiding the pass path.

The guidance panel no longer blocks the path. Chart controls and the event timeline still sit below the first screen, especially with larger text.

Next change: Add a short next-event summary above or beside the chart. Stack timeline names and times at accessibility sizes; let chart size respond to available height.

Implementation directionPassView.swift · eventTable

These are design judgments from the updated screenshots and source review, not measured conversion results.

05 · MEDIUM PRIORITY · PASS COMPARISON

Group compact passes by day.

Standard text now shows three complete opportunities. At larger text, repeating full dates and long direction descriptions makes each row much taller.

Next change: Add day headings and concise rise/peak labels; keep the full direction explanation in pass detail. Retain exact times and reminder indicators without fixed row heights.

Implementation directionAllPassesView.swift · compactPassCell

These are design judgments from the updated screenshots and source review, not measured conversion results.

06 · MEDIUM PRIORITY · REMINDER COMPLETION

Finish the reminder interaction and localization pass.

Saving now waits for the scheduling result and retains the form on failure. Existing reminders remain read-only with Delete, and permission, failure and delivery flows were not exercised by the screenshots.

Next change: Add a visible saved confirmation and a direct Settings action for denied notifications; test retry and repeated taps. Translate the new copy across supported locales and verify long translations. Decide whether editing is needed before labeling an existing reminder “Edit.”

Implementation directionPassAlarmModel · NotificationService · localized strings

These are design judgments from the updated screenshots and source review, not measured conversion results.

PROPOSED ADAPTATION · NOT IMPLEMENTED

Give the inner display two useful jobs.

Keep the selected pass’s sky view visible while browsing other passes or setting its reminder. Use the fold to separate information from controls.

On the outer display, show one clear flow. Keep the selected pass and reminder action together.

Use window space and reserved regions.

For book poses, keep each pane and its controls on one side of the active division. For tabletop poses, put the sky above and the timeline and reminder controls below.

Developer direction

Prototype SwiftUI ArrangementView with .split or .overlay inside the destination. Keep each pane’s scroll container inside the arrangement. Query division and occlusion reserved regions instead of inventing a hinge width. Adapt from current scene geometry and traits, rather than device idiom.

Apple: Preparing your app for iPhone Duo

Audit bars and sheet geometry.

Check that every important action remains reachable when system bars are vertical, and that sheets use their current window dimensions.

Source audit · pending visual verification

Pass and pass-list screens use custom .principal toolbar content. Apple documents different presentation rules for vertical bars; keep essential context in the content area and use semantic toolbar placements.

The reminder form now uses an inline navigation title and a scrolling layout with a bottom safe-area inset. The former UIScreen.main.bounds.height assumption has been removed. Inner-display and sheet behavior still need visual verification.

Apple: Xcode 27.1 release notes

EVIDENCE & LIMITS

What this review verifies.

Captured

Actual iPhone Duo simulator outer display, dark mode, standard and larger text. Home, pass list, pass chart, satellites, planetarium, settings, location, empty alarms, reminder form, and onboarding.

Native scene: 466 × 678 points. Full original images: 1398 × 2034 pixels. Xcode 27.1 beta, build 27A9269; iOS 27.1 beta, build 24A94401.

Still needs verification

Inner display, wide/tall rotation, book and tabletop folds, and continuity across open/close. Computer control cannot currently obtain Device Hub’s interface.

The inner-layout recommendations above are proposals based on Apple’s guidance and a source audit. No resized iPhone 12 or iPad image is used as Duo evidence.

Capture provenance

App baseline: 2.1.0 (24), commit ed8180c3, plus the implementation-pass-1 working-tree patch. Before captures retain the baseline; After captures use the updated production views. A temporary XCTest harness hosts production view fixtures in the simulator’s real UIWindowScene without setting a fixed phone frame. It records bounds, traits, safe areas, and division regions for each image. English, UTC, a frozen orbital epoch, and a test observer keep comparisons reproducible.

The gallery excludes Sky Now’s incomplete catalog-loading fixture. Fixture captures do not verify network loading, real permissions, alarm delivery, or real-device motion. All recommendation priorities are design judgments, not measured conversion results.

View before and after capture metadata

For final acceptance, repeat the complete pose matrix on the actual Duo simulator after Device Hub becomes controllable, then validate sensors and reminders on hardware.
